value.rawCustomCode:
COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

01

I barely have time to shower. How am I supposed to fit workouts in?

Every workout in this challenge is under 30 minutes. Most are closer to 20. They're designed for home — no commute, no waiting for equipment, no gym bag to pack. You do them when the kids are napping, before they wake up, or after they're in bed. Tom built this around the time mums actually have, not the time a fitness magazine assumes you have.

+
02

I've done Weight Watchers. I've tried other things. Nothing has stuck. Why would this be any different?

That's a fair question, and it's worth answering honestly. Most programmes track points or cut foods out — they don't change how you eat in a way that fits real family life. This challenge gives you a nutrition guide built around meals your whole family can eat. No separate cooking. No foods on a banned list. The goal is to build habits that hold when life gets messy — because it always does.

+
03

I'm not a gym person. I've never really exercised properly. Is this going to be too hard?

No gym, ever. Every session is done at home with no equipment. Tom designed these workouts for women who are starting from scratch or getting back into it after a long break. You'll be challenged — that's the point — but nothing here requires any experience or any kit beyond a bit of floor space.

+
04

Is this actually free? What's the catch?

It's free. Thirty days, no card details, no hidden fees.
